display.title: Vov Tishrei: The Yahrzeit of the Shpoler Zeide
display.summary_short: A short introduction to Vov Tishrei, the yahrzeit of the Shpoler Zeide, when his descendants gather to retell his stories and follow his example.
display.summary_long: A two-minute introduction from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that Vov Tishrei, the sixth of Tishrei, is the yahrzeit of the Shpoler Zeide, Rabbi Aryeh Leib ben Boruch. All over the world his many descendants hold gatherings on this day, retell his stories and make resolutions to follow his teachings, and each year more families discover that they are his descendants. Uncle Yossi says that later in the program he will explain how to find out whether you are a descendant, and announces a story that took place on Vov Tishrei 1812, the day the Shpoler Zeide passed away. The clip ends there, before the story and the family information.
display.lesson: On a tzaddik's yahrzeit we retell his stories and try to follow his example.
